title: AssembledOutput
description: Output of the assemble_output MCP tool: the caller's envelope, with validate_output's safe corrections applied, plus a `validation` object. The envelope's own fields are whatever the caller assembled; the optional `schema` argument is what constrains them.

valid.description: True when no issue of severity 'error' remains after the safe corrections. A schema violation is always an error.

issues.description: validate_output's issues (contracts/validation.schema.json), then one issue with check 'schema' per JSON Schema violation, at most 50.

path.description: JSON path of the offending value; '$' for a missing required key at the top level
